items.t: Find Condos Priced Under $500K – Great for First-Time Buyers

faq.a: The $800,000 cap is above the middle of the market: Mission's median for condos and townhomes combined was $430,000 in September 2026, $370,000 below the cap. That median mixes townhomes with condos and swung from $642,500 in August 2026 on a small number of sales, so it shows where the cap sits, not what a typical condo costs.
faq.q: Does the $800K cap cover the typical Mission condo?

faq.a: In September 2026, the urban Mission area had 104 condos and townhomes for sale, Mission West 8 and Hemlock 9, out of 122 across Mission; the rural areas had almost none. Those numbers are condos and townhomes combined, not just condos under $800,000.
faq.q: Where are Mission's condos and townhomes?
